title: Cyclostationary Phase Conditioning for Medical Time Series Diffusion
abstract: arXiv:2609.34965v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Many physiological time series, such as cardiac and brain recordings, exhibit cyclostationarity: their statistics vary periodically with an underlying cycle phase. Corruption from motion, poor contact, and physiological interference obscures morphology needed for diagnosis, making signal restoration essential. Existing diffusion approaches condition on corrupted observations alone and must learn cyclic structure implicitly. We instead propose two inductive biases which encode cyclostationarity: a shift-covariant wavelet representation and dense per-sample phase conditioning inferred from the corrupted input. We further introduce a training-free cyclostationarity index that quantifies phase structure and predicts when phase conditioning will help. Finally, we propose antithetic coupling of reverse trajectories to reduce sampling variance while achieving comparable performance with fivefold fewer network evaluations. Across modal

translated_title: 面向医学时间序列扩散模型的循环平稳相位条件化方法
translated_abstract: 许多生理时间序列，例如心脏和大脑记录，表现出循环平稳性：其统计特性随潜在的循环相位呈周期性变化。来自运动、接触不良和生理干扰的污染掩盖了诊断所需的形态学信息，因此信号恢复至关重要。现有的扩散方法仅以受损观测作为条件，必须隐式地学习循环结构。我们转而提出两种编码循环平稳性的归纳偏置：平移协变小波表示，以及从受损输入推断出的密集逐样本相位条件化。我们进一步引入一种无需训练的循环平稳性指数，用于量化相位结构，并预测相位条件化何时会有帮助。最后，我们提出反向轨迹的对偶耦合方法以降低采样方差，同时以五分之一的网络评估次数实现相当的性能。跨模态……
tldr: 该论文提出编码循环平稳性的两种归纳偏置（平移协变小波表示与逐样本相位条件化）、免训练的循环平稳性指数以及反向轨迹对偶耦合采样策略，显著提升了医学时间序列的扩散恢复效果，并将网络评估次数减少至原来的五分之一。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes two inductive biases encoding cyclostationarity (a shift-covariant wavelet representation and dense per-sample phase conditioning), a training-free cyclostationarity index, and antithetic coupling of reverse trajectories, improving medical time series diffusion restoration while requiring fivefold fewer network evaluations.
